plugin.name: Query catalog
plugin.description: Indexes .sql query files from folders you grant; maps {{entity}} placeholders to real tables and runs them read-only.
setting.mappingFile.hint: Full path of the mapping file inside a granted folder. Empty: mapping.yaml, mapping.yml or mapping.json at the top of a granted folder.
reason.noHeader: No YAML header at the top of the file
reason.unclosedHeader: The YAML header is not closed with ---
reason.badHeader: The YAML header cannot be read
reason.badId: The id may only contain letters, digits, _ and -, separated by dots
reason.badParams: params must be a list or a map
reason.badParam: A parameter name is not valid
reason.noBody: The file has no query after the header
reason.duplicateId: Another file already uses this id
reason.mappingUnreadable: The mapping file cannot be read
reason.mappingParse: The mapping file cannot be parsed
reason.mappingShape: The mapping file has no entities
message.savedAs: Saved as a new SQL statement
warn.undeclared: Parameter :{name} is used but not declared in the header
warn.unused: Parameter {name} is declared but not used
warn.noMapping: The query uses placeholders, but the mapping is not available: {reason}
warn.missing: The file {path} no longer exists; this entry is kept for its history
field.asOf.hint: Versioned tables show the version in force at this time (UTC); empty = now
sent.expanded: Not run yet. With the mapping applied the query reads:
index.about: The catalog indexes the .sql files in the folders you granted, when the workspace opens and when you re-index. Files whose header cannot be read are listed here.
index.title: Catalog index
error.noSource: No data source: set one in the header, the environment (datasource) or the workspace (datasource.default)
error.param.datetime: {name} must be a date and time
error.param.enum: {name} must be one of the listed values
reason.mappingNotAbsolute: The mapping file setting must be a full path
message.truncated: Stopped at {max} files or {depth} folder levels: nothing was marked missing.
index.more: …and {count} more (re-index to see them all in the result).
